meta.name: etetoolkit
meta.description: Analyze, manipulate, compare, annotate, and visualize phylogenetic or other hierarchical trees with ETE 4. Use for Newick/Nexus tree I/O, topology edits and pattern matching, Robinson-Foulds comparisons, gene-tree evolutionary events and reconciliation, NCBI/GTDB taxonomy, SmartView exploration, and publication rendering. Do not use it to infer trees from raw sequences; align sequences and infer a tree first.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 比较和可视化树状亲缘关系，生成科研论文级图表
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果研究物种演化，需要把树形关系整理成清晰的图。
copy.tagline_en: Compare and render phylogenetic trees for polished scientific figures.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you study evolution and often need visual comparisons for your papers.

howto.what: 装上后 Claude 能读写、编辑和比较系统发育树（Newick/NHX 等），检测基因树上的重复与物种形成事件、划分直系与旁系同源，接入 NCBI 分类信息，并把树渲染成 PDF/SVG 图。
howto.when: 当你提到 Newick/NHX 树文件、拓扑编辑、同源分析或 NCBI 分类等需求时接管。它不负责从原始序列推断树，需先比对序列并建好树。

say.text: 读入 tree.nw，做中点定根，另存为 rooted_tree.nw
say.note: 会输出重新定根后的树文件

say.text: 把 tree.nw 渲染成 PDF，并按节点支持度着色
say.note: 生成带支持度颜色的 PDF 图

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude reads, edits and compares phylogenetic trees (Newick/NHX), detects duplication and speciation events, separates orthologs from paralogs, links NCBI taxonomy, and renders trees to PDF/SVG.
howto.when_en: Use when you mention Newick/NHX tree files, topology edits, orthology or NCBI taxonomy. It does not infer trees from raw sequences—align and build the tree first.

say_en.text: Load tree.nw, midpoint-root it, and write rooted_tree.nw
Compare tree1.nw and tree2.nw with the Robinson-Foulds distance
Render tree.nw to PDF, coloring nodes by support
